maddeler.e:
أتصادق (form VI)
# أَتَصَادَقُ (ʔataṣādaqu) /ʔa.ta.sˤaː.da.qu/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of تَصَادَقَ (taṣādaqa)
# أَتَصَادَقَ (ʔataṣādaqa) /ʔa.ta.sˤaː.da.qa/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of تَصَادَقَ (taṣādaqa)
# أَتَصَادَقْ (ʔataṣādaq) /ʔa.ta.sˤaː.daq/: first-person singular non-past active jussive of تَصَادَقَ (taṣādaqa)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
